airflow.note: the cooling system provides front-to-back chassis cooling (Figure 38 for models without PoE).

built-in-power-and-fans.note: Hardware guide, Power Supply in EX2300 Switches: "The power supply in EX2300 switches is built in along the rear panel of the chassis"; Table 34 lists "Switch with built-in power supply"; the cooling system is "two fans built-in along the rear of the chassis" and the non-PoE rears (Figures 11 to 13) show a single exhaust opening. Nothing in the guide describes removing or replacing either. They are part of the chassis, not bays and not components. The guide's CLI inventory examples name the supply JPSU-170W-AC and JPSU-450W-AC-AFO as built-in items of the EX2300-C-12P and EX2300-24P.

chassis.note: Table 3: height 1.75 in (4.45 cm), width 17.4 in (44.19 cm) and 19 in (48.26 cm) with the mounting brackets attached, depth 10.2 in (25.9 cm) for models without PoE capability, weight 7.25 lb (3.29 kg) and 7.83 lb (3.55 kg) for the EX2300-24T-DC. 441.9 x 44.45 x 259.0 is carried: the metric as printed for width and depth and the height as the 1U pitch Table 35 gives (1.75 in, 4.45 cm). The photographs show no ears, and the jack pitch closing on the registry at that width says the figure is the body.

colour.note: median of the bare front plate in the 24P photograph (#919599); the plate at the top right #6e7276.

front-console.note: estimated - the mini-USB console port (guide Figure 3, callout 5, printed CON) is drawn as chassis art, a 7.9 x 4.6 mm shell with its opening, read off the 24P and 48P photographs (25 x 14 px and 24 x 14 px at 3.27 px per mm). It is not a component: the library has no mini-USB receptacle and its DCIM export has no row for one, so a placed part would export nothing. The rear RJ-45 console port is a component and exports.

front-layout.note: estimated - the 24-port front is the 24P photograph's, without the PoE items: the guide says the PoE lamp is present only on models with PoE capability, so three port-mode lamps (SPD, DX, EN) and no POE legend, and the red PoE+ mark beside the model name is not drawn. No photograph of a non-PoE front exists, so the model name is printed EX2300 as on the PoE units. The 24 jacks stand in two shells of six columns, the first jack at 187.0 mm and the shell step 88.8 mm (6 x 13.97 plus a 5.0 gutter), right-aligned so that the last shell ends where the uplink block begins at 364.6; the rows are 14.8 mm apart and the upper row is turned 180 so its lamps and keyway are above, as the photograph shows. The four SFP+ cages abut on the registry pitch of 14.25 at 364.6, one row. A darker plate carries the model legend and lamps at the top right and runs down the far right edge. The hexagonal vent fields along the top edge and above the uplinks, and the slotted row along the bottom edge, are read off the same photographs.

gate-1.note: The 24P front photograph is 1500 x 190 px with the body 1446 px across and 143 down: 10.11 against the stated 441.9 / 44.45 = 9.94, 1.7 percent out, so x is taken at 3.272 px per mm from the width and y at 3.217 px per mm from the height. The ganged jack pitch then reads 45.7 px = 13.96 mm, the 0.550 in pitch the registry records for the ganged RJ-45 cell, on a quantity the scale never saw. The 48P photograph agrees on every feature both show to within 0.7 mm in x and 1.4 mm in y; the y values here are the mean of the two. The DC rear photograph (1455 px across, 3.293 px per mm, 3.217 down) and the 48P rear (3.234 across, 3.09 down) give the rear positions. Every position is estimated and good to about a millimetre.

lamps.note: Hardware guide, Tables 4 to 12 and Figures 24, 26 and 27. Each RJ-45 port and uplink has two lamps, Link/Activity and Status; Figure 24 puts Link/Activity on one corner of the jack and Status on the other. The Status lamp reads out whichever of SPD, DX and EN the Factory Reset/Mode button has selected (PoE too on a PoE model), shown by which port-mode lamp is lit. SYS is green, ALM red or yellow and MST green. The jack lamps keep the component's link and activity vocabulary because a block cannot override it per lamp. On the uplinks the left slot is taken as Link/Activity and the right as Status by analogy with the jacks, which no figure confirms, so it is estimated.

port-numbering.note: photo-measured - the photograph prints each column's two numbers in orange under the shell, the even number up and left and the odd number down and right (0 and 1, 2 and 3, ... 22 and 23), so the upper jack takes the even number; the uplinks print 0 to 3 in white between their two lamps. Port numbers are as printed on the metal, from 0. The Junos interface names are not printed: the guide's Table 2 gives PIC 0 as 24x10/100/1000 Base-T and PIC 1 as 4x10G SFP/SFP+, i.e. ge-0/0/0 to ge-0/0/23 and xe-0/1/0 to xe-0/1/3; they are recorded here and not in an interfaces block because the faceplate does not print them. Table 11 notes that on the EX2300-24T only the ports labelled 0/0 through 0/15 support half-duplex.

power.note: Table 14: maximum power consumed 55 W for the EX2300-24T and for the EX2300-24T-DC, no PoE; Table 15: 100 through 240 VAC, 50/60 Hz, 2.5 A at 100 VAC and 1.25 A at 240 VAC; Table 16: DC input -48 through -60 VDC, 2.8 A maximum, power supply output 100 W, holdup 5 ms minimum. The AC legend on the rear is drawn from Table 15 (2.5A) and not read off a figure.

rear-dc.note: photo-measured - the EX2300-24T-DC rear from the studio photograph named ex2300-24p-rear-high.jpg at 3.293 px per mm: the same management and console cluster and earthing plate as the AC rear, the ESD symbol and point lower and to the right of the plate (64.4 and 77.5 mm, 21 mm down) instead of beside it, the single fan at 115.7 mm, nine screws along the lower edge, no earth symbol left of the plate, and a four-pole DC terminal block 52.6 mm wide at 377.3 mm in place of the AC inlet. Figure 13 draws the earth symbol beside the plate while the photograph does not, so the two disagree on that one mark and the photograph won; the rest of Figure 13's arrangement matches the photograph. The block is drawn as chassis art (a plate, a dark strip, two mounting screws and four terminals, sized off the photograph) and is not a component, because the DCIM export has no row for a part of that kind and a placed part would export nothing. The legend printed over the block reads DC INPUT : -44V- -72V, a DC symbol, 3.7A Max; the guide's Table 16 gives -48 through -60 VDC at 2.8 A maximum (the printed range is the wider), both are recorded and the printed text is drawn with the DC symbol the photograph and Figure 13 both print. The guide's figure labels the poles INPUT 1 and INPUT 2 under the block; the photograph shows no label there and none is drawn.

rear-layout.note: estimated - positions off the 48P rear photograph (3.234 px per mm across, 3.09 px per mm down) for the management and console jacks, USB port, earthing terminal, ESD point and AC inlet, which Figure 11 shows at the same places on the 24-port non-PoE AC model. The single exhaust fan sits at 0.308 of the width (136.1 mm) in Figure 11, read off the drawing. The guide's drawing puts a serial number label and a CLEI label on the rear; the studio photographs show neither, so none is drawn. The nine edge screws are read off Figure 11 (the body 874 px across at 1.978 px per mm; the first at 51.6 mm, the last at 424.7 mm, centres, drawn at y 37.4 as on the DC rear) and are estimated. The held NetBox 24T rear elevation (juniper-ex2300-24t.rear.png, 530 x 50 px, the only picture held of this AC rear) draws the same nine in the same grouping, two left of the fan, five between the fan and the label area and two beside the inlet, with each within about 8 mm of Figure 11 except the second, which is about 18 mm further left; the figure's positions are kept because the elevation is too small to measure closer. Figure 11 prints 12A Max above the inlet where Table 15 gives 2.5 A at 100 VAC for the 24T; the legend is drawn as 2.5A Max, the 12A Max being likely a copy of the 48P legend in the figure.

sources.note: EX2300 Switch Hardware Guide, Juniper Networks, published 2025-08-12 (314 pages; https://www.juniper.net/documentation/us/en/hardware/ex2300/ex2300.pdf): Figure 3 and Figure 4 (front panels), Figure 9 to Figure 13 (rear panels), Table 1 (models), Table 3 (chassis size and weight), Tables 4 to 12 (LEDs), the cooling system section, Tables 14 to 16 (power) and Table 34 (parts list). Juniper's own straight-on studio photographs of the EX2300-24P and EX2300-48P fronts, of the EX2300-48P rear, and of a DC-powered 24-port rear (file named ex2300-24p-rear-high.jpg, which shows the DC terminal block and a single fan, so it is the EX2300-24T-DC rear and not the 24P). The maker's image library holds no photograph of the EX2300-24T itself (the 48T front address was tried and returned a page, not an image). The HPE PSNow datasheet (a00151236enw) did not answer when fetched, so no datasheet is cited. The held NetBox elevations of the 24T (juniper-ex2300-24t.front.png, 530 x 49 px, and juniper-ex2300-24t.rear.png, 530 x 50 px) are the only pictures held of the EX2300-24T itself: the front confirms the 24-port jacks-on-the-right layout and the rear the AC arrangement and its edge screws. They are too small to measure from and no position is read off the front.

uplinks.note: photo-measured - one row of four SFP+/SFP cages numbered 0 to 3 with a pair of lamp slots flanking each numeral; the guide gives 4x10G SFP/SFP+ and says the ports can be Virtual Chassis ports with SFP+ transceivers but not with SFP.
